issues.desc: CHK-001 verification should explicitly include the staging/client env side of the ordinary bundle. Evidence: checklist read via `sed -n 1,260p .lattice/story/actives/B-491e/checklist.json` names `lattice_authority_trust.env` and `lattice_senior_*`, while `sed -n 1,240p docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-cli-authority-client-receipt-ref.md` shows the ordinary bundle pair is `lattice_authority_trust.env` + `lattice_staging-client.env`. Without naming `lattice_staging-client.env`, local client-env generation could survive the intended public-CLI cleanup.

CHK-003 is verification/process work rather than a distinct user-observable acceptance item, and it overlaps CHK-001/CHK-002 verificationIntent. Evidence: checklist read via `sed -n 1,260p .lattice/story/actives/B-491e/checklist.json`; CHK-003 title is `Verify CLI tests after cleanup` and userSees is test pass/fail rather than a product behavior. Prefer folding these test expectations into verification evidence for the functional/docs items, or restating it as a user-observable CLI behavior that remains intact.
